channel.title: Pier & Point · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Smith Cardiovascular Research Building (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building's…
item.description: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building's note now says two contractor pages describe a five-story, 232,000-square-foot building in their text but list 323,000 square feet in their details box, so the size is not settled. The $196 million they give is the construction contract amount, not the project's total cost. Source: https://www.tutorperini.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/; https://www.rsconstruction.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/.

item.title: Correction · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building…
item.description: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building page now dates its $254 million to the Regents' November 13, 2007 budget amendment and calls it a budget. It also lists the contractors' conflicting sizes without the unreadable Architizer figures, and notes a six-level tag in OpenStreetMap. Source: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings minutes, November 13, 2007 (regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/minutes/2007/gb1107.pdf); Industrial Info Resources, May 14, 2008; Tutor Perini and Rudolph and Sletten project pages; OpenStreetMap way 135103721.

item.title: Correction · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building's…
item.description: The Smith Cardiovascular Research Building's size now leads with 232,000 sq ft, as a 2008 groundbreaking report and its contractors' own descriptions give it; its $254 million cost now cites that readable 2008 report. Source: https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/construction-begins-on-254-million-cardiovascular-research-institute-for-ucsf--132778; https://www.tutorperini.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/; https://www.rsconstruction.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/.

item.title: Correction · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: The record gave 236,000 sq ft and $254…
item.description: The record gave 236,000 sq ft and $254 million from an Architizer listing that could not be read; two readable contractor pages give 323,000 sq ft and a $196 million contract amount, so the record now states the conflict instead of one figure. The September 2007 Regents minutes give about $180 million in gifts in hand but no project budget, so the $254 million clause was removed from that milestone. The opening is 2010 without a month (UCSF's history gives the year only), and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: Tutor Perini, UCSF Smith Cardiovascular Research Building (https://www.tutorperini.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/); Rudolph and Sletten, UCSF Smith Cardiovascular Research Building (https://www.rsconstruction.com/projects/education/ucsf-smith-cardiovascular-research-building/); UC Regents minutes, 2007-09-18 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/minutes/2007/gb907.pdf); A History of UCSF, 2010+ (https://history.library.ucsf.edu/2010.html).

item.title: Planned · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: UC Regents Committee on Grounds… (Nov 13, 2007)
item.description: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings 'approved the President's recommendations and voted to present them to the Board', including an amendment of the capital budget to $254 million for the Mission Bay Cardiovascular Research Building (17A/B) (gifts $198 million, external financing $42 million, campus funds $14 million) and approval of the building's design; the minutes record the committee's vote, and the Board's own vote was not read (Nov 13, 2007). Source: The Regents of the University of California, 2007-11-13.
item.source: The Regents of the University of California, 2007-11-13

item.title: Planned · Smith Cardiovascular Research Building: UC Regents Committee on Grounds… (Sep 18, 2007)
item.description: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings holds a preliminary design review of the Mission Bay Cardiovascular Research Building; the campus reports it is expecting a $100 million cash gift and a matching $50 million gift (bringing the campus close to $180 million in gifts in hand; the minutes give no project budget) and plans to seek full design approval in November 2007 (Sep 18, 2007). Source: The Regents of the University of California, 2007-09-18.
item.source: The Regents of the University of California, 2007-09-18
